evals.description: Skill triggers for non-trivial multi-module refactoring requests with meaningful constraints.

input.prompt: Refactor the authentication system across the API gateway, user service, and shared middleware. The current implementation mixes session tokens with JWT and has inconsistent error handling.

assertions.description: Non-trivial multi-module refactor should trigger workflow-spec-lite.
A spec file should be created under docs/specs/.
Spec must include a Summary section.
Spec must include a Goals section.
Spec must include a Non-Goals section.
Spec must include a Constraints section.
Spec must include a Risks section.
Spec must include an Acceptance section.

evals.description: Skill does not create root docs/specs/** when maintaining the public agent-ecosystem repository.

input.prompt: Add a new validation check to the release validator script.

assertions.description: Non-trivial feature work should still trigger the skill.
Skill must not create root docs/specs/ in the public agent-ecosystem repo.
Skill must never create a plan.md under docs/specs/.

evals.description: Skill does not activate for trivial single-file fixes with clear acceptance criteria.

input.prompt: Fix the typo in README.md line 42: 'teh' should be 'the'.

assertions.description: Trivial single-file typo fix should not trigger workflow-spec-lite.
